name: HT06a2. Unassisted (Community)
description: Number of HIV self-test kits distributed as unassisted in community
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_self_testing a
JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
  ON mdp.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE
  a.encounter_date >= :startDate
  AND a.encounter_date <= :endDate
  AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  AND a.distribution_model = '4f4e6d1d-4343-42cc-ba47-2319b8a84369'
  AND a.hiv_self_testing_approach = '534658fe-3682-4007-bee1-3f600edb2818'
;
